problem_statement: The radio driver and NCP cannot schedule a reception window at a specific future radio time. There is no way to ask the radio to turn on for a given channel for a defined duration starting at a given time (the 'MAC RX At' feature), and the NCP does not recognize the corresponding property. After a scheduled reception window elapses the radio should return to its prior (idle) channel; before the window starts it should be on the requested channel, and outside the window it should be off. Required behavior: support requesting a timed reception window (start time, duration, channel) and have the radio/channel reflect the scheduled window as time advances.
